summary: Mike DeCourcy reviews the USMNT's 3-1 friendly loss to Germany in East Hartford, Conn., on Oct. 14, 2023. Gio Reyna started and played well for 45 minutes, and Christian Pulisic scored a fine opener. The team collapsed after halftime, exposing the lack of a proven replacement for the injured defensive midfielder Tyler Adams, as Yunus Musah struggled in that role.
one_line: The USMNT blew an early lead and lost 3-1 to Germany, with Gio Reyna impressing in the first half but the midfield lacking Tyler Adams.
key_facts: The USMNT lost 3-1 to Germany in a Saturday friendly in East Hartford, Conn., after blowing an early lead.
Christian Pulisic scored the opening goal in the 27th minute, driving right and curling a shot into the upper right corner past Marc-Andre Ter Stegen.
The game was 1-1 at halftime; Niclas Fullkrug scored in the 58th minute and Jamal Musiala three minutes later.
Gio Reyna started and played 45 minutes, after playing only 27 minutes in his one club appearance this season for Borussia Dortmund.
Reyna was injured in June while playing for the U.S. and missed all of preseason training and nearly two months of the Bundesliga season.
Tyler Adams is the one proven defensive midfielder (No. 6) on the USMNT roster and has been absent since injuring his hamstring in the spring; he may need a second surgery.
Yunus Musah was deployed in the defensive midfield role and it did not work, as Germany plowed through the center of the park.
Musah is elite as a box-to-box midfielder and plays a more attacking role at AC Milan with Pulisic.
Luca de la Torre replaced Reyna and dulled the attack, according to the author.
Blame for the German goals was shared by Sergino Dest, de la Torre, Chris Richards, Weston McKennie, Tim Ream and Joe Scally.
Coach Gregg Berhalter said the goals came from 'fine moments, these split seconds' of positioning and gaps in the back line, and that controlling the tempo is what the team needs to learn.
An early ball over the top to Pulisic was stopped by an offside call that both player and coach disputed.
The author calls this possibly the most challenging friendly before the 2026 World Cup in North America.
